formula: YoY change in the single-quarter operating_profit / revenue ratio; quarterly cumulative flows are differenced only across consecutive same-fiscal-year quarters.
pit_rule: For every source period use financial_pit_date's statutory-deadline fallback; each quarterized margin is available only after both cumulative reports it depends on, and the YoY change only after both year-separated margins are available. Carry no more than 180 calendar days.
data_scope: financial input, historical membership, current industry mapping, prebuilt factor values, and trading-date calendar only
limitations: Local financial tables are current snapshots; statutory-date fallback reduces use of suspicious announcement dates but cannot remove restatement/snapshot leakage.
Current industry classifications are used to exclude financials.
